llm.summary: The skill is mostly a disclosed TikTok Shop integration, but it exposes broader authenticated shop and return/refund proxy access than its narrow reject-reason description suggests.

dimensions.detail: Network calls and API-key use fit the integration purpose, but the gateway host can be selected through environment variables and receives the API key plus session metadata.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hooks, package installation, or automatic startup behavior were found; the dependency checker only searches for the required auth skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The generic proxy accepts caller-supplied path, method, query string, and body for broad authorization/ and return_refund/ prefixes, rather than only the declared reject-reasons endpoint.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background worker, privilege escalation, or local token storage was found; the skill relies on openId and backend token handling through the gateway.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The front matter describes Get Reject Reasons and says authorization is out of scope, while the artifact also documents and implements authorized-shop lookup plus a generic authenticated developerProxy caller.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing if you only want a narrow reject-reason lookup. It can use an authenticated TikTok Shop ERP context to list authorized shops and proxy broader authorization/return_refund API calls, so install it only where that broader access is acceptable and the gateway environment is trusted.
llm.findings:
[TT3] expected: A remote gateway call is expected for this skill, but the artifact does not pin or validate the environment-selected gateway host before sending authorization and session headers.
[TP4] unexpected: The artifact-backed issue is real: the skill presents a narrow reject-reasons purpose while exposing shop enumeration and a broad path/method proxy.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The registered get_authorized_shops API and references expose seller shop metadata despite the top-level statement that authorization is not included.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The documentation is internally inconsistent: it says authorization is out of scope while listing authorization/202309/shops as part of this skill.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The generic proxy allows arbitrary methods and bodies under broad prefixes, which could reach endpoints beyond the documented read-only reject-reason workflow.
[SQP-2] expected: The dependency checker's searchedRoots output is a minor diagnostic disclosure, not core to the security verdict.
